findings.detail: The required-field validation order differs from the plan. The plan lists businessName -> registrationNumber -> wasteCarrierLicense -> serviceAreas -> wasteCategories -> contactPhone -> contactEmail, but the implementation validates the five scalars first (incl. contactPhone/contactEmail) and only then the two list fields (serviceAreas, wasteCategories). Behaviorally correct (it still names the first missing field and the FEAT-003 findings document the actual order), so not a must-fix.
findings.fix: Optional: reorder the serviceAreas/wasteCategories checks to sit between wasteCarrierLicense and contactPhone to match the plan's stated order exactly, or leave as-is since the FEAT findings already record the real order.

summary: Phase-1 marketplace change APPROVED. The disintermediation invariant holds: _creq_view unlocks only on (status in UNLOCK_STATUSES and waste), _chat_enabled reads CHAT_STATUSES, both list_requests loops gate the waste load on 'in UNLOCK_STATUSES', and approve_request sets only 'accepted' passing no waste. UNLOCK_STATUSES == CHAT_STATUSES == ('confirmed','collected','disputed') with 'collecting' correctly kept out as a waste-item-only status. MEDIUM-1 (confirm_deal) is implemented with the one-confirmed-deal guard, strict write order (collect-request 'confirmed' first, then waste-item write that returns 500 without unlocking on failure, then best-effort try/except auto-close that never raises). MEDIUM-2 (post-confirm cancel) uses the paginated wasteIndex 'no other confirmed deal' scan, fails safe (treats a scan error as other_confirmed=True so it won't wrongly reopen), does NOT restore losing auto-closed quotes, and leaves paymentStatus behind the Phase-2 comment. raise_dispute only from confirmed/collected. NITs #3 (mark_done unconditional-set comment), #5 (upload contentType allow-list image/png,image/jpeg,application/pdf), #7 (token-scoped admin comment), and #4/#6 test assertions are all present. The prefix dispatcher runs ahead of the endswith chain so /admin/collectors/{id}/approve is not captured by endswith('approve'). No real-payment code: only paymentStatus='not_required' and '# Phase 2' comment stubs. The Future Actions tab (renderFurtherActions and related) is byte-untouched. Infra adds CollectorsTable+statusIndex, a private all-PAB CollectorDocsBucket, the admins Cognito group, shared-role IAM grants, env vars and the output. Verification: pytest green (44 passed), node --check frontend/app.js clean. Company/business (collector) account registration is implemented end to end (apply/submit/upload-url/me + admin approve/reject/suspend queue + frontend Become-a-collector and admin overlay). One NIT only (collector_submit field-order), which is non-blocking.
